chunks: Or say when he sees the punishment: 'If only I had another chance, I would be among the good-doers.'

key_terms.كُرَّةٌ: A return/chance (to go back to life)
key_terms.مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ: Among the good-doers (those who perform righteous deeds)

ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers wish for when they see the punishment on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the moment of 'regret' (Tasbib) which occurs after the seal of death is set, distinguishing it from earlier repentance. It underscores the concept of 'Barzakh' as the barrier preventing return, emphasizing that the opportunity for righteous deeds (Ihsan) is exclusive to earthly life. This serves as a practical warning against procrastination in spiritual preparation.
